tier_description: Factual Lookup — questions with a single, unambiguous answer retrievable directly from one data source

category_descriptions.A: Course Info (20 questions) — course names, units, descriptions
category_descriptions.B: Prerequisites (10 questions) — prerequisite and co-requisite chains
category_descriptions.C: Schedule/Offering (20 questions) — when/where/who teaches a course in a specific semester
category_descriptions.D: Program Requirements (30 questions) — required courses, concentrations, minors, degree rules
category_descriptions.E: Policy (20 questions) — registration rules, grading standards, overload limits, deadlines

schema.persona_id: Persona identifier (e.g. P-003) or null for generic questions
schema.question: Natural-language question as a student would ask it
schema.answer: Single correct factual answer directly from source data
schema.source_file: Relative path to the data file containing the answer
schema.source_field: JSON field or document section where the answer is found
schema.verification_note: Brief explanation of where and how the answer is verified

quality_notes: All answers are directly verifiable in the cited source file and field — no inference required
Each question spans exactly one domain (courses, schedules, programs, or policies)
Schedule questions reference specific semesters present in the data (Spring 2026, Fall 2025)
All course codes referenced exist in data/courses/
Persona IDs reference profiles in Benchmark/student persona/
20 distinct personas are used — one per persona-grounded question
No two questions are trivially similar or duplicate
